text.p: SKOPJE, May 20 (Reuter) these are the leading stories in Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Despite additional army measures for protection of the Macedonian border towards Albania, gunfire is still frequent because of small Albanian police force whic is unable to do its job properly, said Macedonian army colonel Josip Bosevski.
- Reshuffle of the republic's government can be expected soon, paper quotes reliable political sources.

- The Macedonian parliamentarians on visit to Slovenia. Tito Petkovski and Janez Podobnik, speakers of the Macedonian and Slovenian parliaments, said both countries are Europe-oriented and will continue to support each other in their international affirmation.
